newSection.title: A Texas higher-education application route
newSection.text: A scholarship packet posted by the Alabama-Coushatta Tribe of Texas in October 2025 shows how its education office organized an application process for college support. It connects admission records, transcripts, a student's study plans and a college financial-aid assessment; its agreement ties funds to educational expenses. This dated administrative source offers a route into the Texas government's institutional life. Student experiences and results remain unexamined, and the packet does not describe the Louisiana or Oklahoma governments.
